Black_Spots.quote: Small, sunken, dark brown spots on leaves, fruits, stems and/or flowers; infected fruits dropping from plants before they reach maturity; damage to fruit is more pronounced during warm and humid periods of the growing season.
The disease is characterized by dark spots that appear in slight depressions on flowers, pods, leaves and stems.

Rotten_Stem.quote: The disease starts with the browning and death of underground roots, followed by the death of aerial roots. Subsequently the leaves and stem begins to shrivel and eventually the total collapse of the plant occurs.
Brown lesions on roots which turn brown and dry out; plants begin to rot at the apical tip and stop growing.
